<script>AttachXFormValueChangeEventById("fd_trigger", function(value, domElement) {
var copy = GetXFormFieldById("fd_copy")[0];
copy.value=value;
if(value.indexOf("A")>=0){
common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_toggle_row",true,true,false);
}else{
common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_toggle_row",false,false,false);
$('input[name="extendDataFormInfo.value(fd_clear)"]').val("");
$('input[name="_extendDataFormInfo.value(fd_clear)"]').prop("checked", false);
}
});</script>
